name: parentix
description: Parentix — parental control & digital safety platform (Admin Dashboard, Family App, Child App, Google Cloud backend)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/family-app && npm run build --workspace apps/admin-dashboard
scripts.lint: eslint apps/admin-dashboard/src apps/family-app/src apps/child-app/src apps/child-app/App.js packages/shared/src services/api/src
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix services/api ci && npm --prefix apps/child-app ci
scripts.test:e2e: npm --prefix services/api run test:e2e && npm --prefix apps/child-app run test:e2e
